name: Tile
description: Partition loop nests into smaller rectangular blocks by tiling dimensions, such that intermediate results fit in L1/L2 cache. Applies transform.structured.tile_using_for to generate nested scf.for loops with tensor slicing.

parameters.name: tile_sizes
parameters.description: List of tile sizes for each loop dimension. A value of 0 means 'no tiling for that dimension'. The length must match the loop rank of the target operation.
